capabilities: Sync vault folders with folders in Google Shared Drives
Manage who can open each synced folder
Add people by email as Viewer, Commenter, Editor or Manager
Change roles or remove access without leaving Obsidian
disambiguation: Despite the name, GSync Teams never syncs files itself; it only adds Shared Drive folders and access management on top of GSync.
extras: One-time payment, no subscription; 2 devices per user; tiered pricing for 3-30 users. Without a paid license key the plugin does nothing. Works offline after activation (120 days); no telemetry, analytics or ads.
intentEvidence: An add-on for GSync, the free two-way Google Drive sync plugin for Obsidian.
problem: GSync alone cannot sync folders inside Google Shared Drives or control who may view, comment or edit each synced folder without leaving Obsidian.

relations.evidence: GSync does all the syncing. GSync Teams never syncs files itself; it plugs into GSync.

summary: Add-on for GSync that syncs vault folders with Google Shared Drives and manages per-folder access roles from Obsidian.
